cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(butler_cmake C)
find_package(Ruby REQUIRED)
add_library(butler_native MODULE ../butler_native.c)
target_include_directories(butler_native PRIVATE ${Ruby_INCLUDE_DIRS})
set_target_properties(butler_native PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
if(APPLE)
  target_link_options(butler_native PRIVATE "-undefined" "dynamic_lookup")
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND ${Ruby_EXECUTABLE} --disable=gems -rrbconfig -e "print RbConfig::CONFIG['DLEXT']" OUTPUT_VARIABLE RUBY_DLEXT)
set_target_properties(butler_native PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".${RUBY_DLEXT}")
